title: Read dumpbin's export list
description:
Write a reader for the table `dumpbin /exports` prints, so a tool can compare two versions of a DLL.

```cpp
std::vector<std::string> exportedNames(const std::string& dumpbinOutput);
```

The table starts after the heading line that contains the words `ordinal`, `hint`, `RVA` and `name`. Each following line that starts (after spaces) with a number is one export:

```
          1    0 00011023 stackHeight = @ILT+30(stackHeight)
          2    1 000110A5 stackWeight = @ILT+160(stackWeight)
          4      000111D6 [NONAME]
```

- The columns are the ordinal, the hint (missing for an export without a name), the 8-digit hexadecimal RVA, then the name.
- The name is the word right after the RVA. Anything after it (`= @ILT+...`) is ignored.
- For `[NONAME]`, use `#` followed by the ordinal, such as `#4`.
- Stop at the first blank line after the table has started, or at a line starting with `Summary`.

Return the names in the order they appear.
hints: After you find the heading, there is a blank line before the first row. Only stop on a blank line once you have read at least one row.
The RVA is always 8 hexadecimal digits, and the hint is a short decimal number. If the second word is not 8 characters long, it is the hint: skip it.
unitTests:
const std::string sample =
    "Dump of file StoneMath.dll

File Type: DLL

  Section contains the following exports for StoneMath.dll

"
    "    00000000 characteristics
           4 number of functions
           3 number of names

"
    "    ordinal hint RVA      name

"
    "          1    0 00011023 stackHeight = @ILT+30(stackHeight)
"
    "          2    1 000110A5 stackWeight = @ILT+160(stackWeight)
"
    "          3    2 0001C000 internalCounter
"
    "          4      000111D6 [NONAME]

"
    "  Summary

        1000 .data
";
TEST("the sample") { CHECK_EQ(exportedNames(sample), (std::vector<std::string>{ "stackHeight", "stackWeight", "internalCounter", "#4" })); }
TEST("no table") { CHECK(exportedNames("Dump of file x.dll

File Type: DLL
").empty()); }
TEST("Windows line endings") { CHECK_EQ(exportedNames("    ordinal hint RVA      name

          7    0 00001000 Go

"), (std::vector<std::string>{ "Go" })); }
TEST("stops at the blank line") { CHECK_EQ(exportedNames("ordinal hint RVA name
  1 0 00001000 A

  2 1 00002000 B
"), (std::vector<std::string>{ "A" })); }
lessonTitle: Inspecting DLLs with dumpbin and Dependencies
